methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Virginia Tech researchers look to AI to ease difficult workplace conversations
signals.signal_reading: Virginia Tech developing AI tools for workplace conversations demonstrates deep research capability in a non-NoVA region, signaling potential for distributed AI fluency if such tools become accessible beyond the institution itself.

signals.title: RiverStreet Networks removed from multiple broadband deployment projects in rural Virginia after years of delays
signals.signal_reading: RiverStreet's failure to complete broadband for 30,000+ rural customers in Southwest Virginia directly undermines the infrastructure prerequisite for any AI capability distribution, reinforcing concentration in already-connected metros.

signals.title: Roanoke College launches WorkAI Lab to prepare leaders for new era of technology - Roanoke College
signals.signal_reading: Roanoke College's WorkAI Lab launch signals institutional investment in distributed AI capability-building outside major metros, potentially creating peer networks for deeper fluency if it extends beyond campus boundaries.

signals.title: New partnership between VCU and AI Ready RVA aims to boost AI education, innovation and community impact - VCU News
signals.signal_reading: VCU's partnership with AI Ready RVA aims for broad community impact through education, but platform-oriented approach suggests shallow distribution rather than deep technical capability building across Richmond's diverse population.

signals.title: How Fairfax County police are using AI — and why opponents are concerned - NBC4 Washington
signals.signal_reading: Fairfax County deploying AI cameras and advanced policing tech demonstrates deep, specialized implementation concentrated in NoVA's well-resourced jurisdiction, widening capability gap with localities lacking similar budgets and expertise.
